---
name: Research review
about: Monthly review of upstream projects and publications (docs/research/README.md)
title: "research: review YYYY-MM"
labels: research
---

Follow the process in `docs/research/README.md`.

- [ ] **Collect:** check every "Watch for" item in `docs/research/sources.md`
      and run discovery searches.
- [ ] **Triage:** drop items that affect no port, ADR, security boundary,
      licence or milestone.
- [ ] **Evaluate:** assign evidence levels and compare with the current ADRs.
- [ ] **Record:** update `sources.md` (dates, licences, access log) and
      `findings.md`.
- [ ] **Propose:** open at most 3 Architecture proposal issues and link them
      here.
- [ ] **Report:** open a PR titled `research: review YYYY-MM` for maintainer
      approval.
